name: Boss Arena Mastery Loop
description: An end-to-end RPG build-and-encounter spine: level growth, durable specialization, gated actives, deduplicated mastery, deterministic elite waves, and scripted multi-phase bosses. Boss health, time, and condition transitions own stable phase ledgers and once-only adds; existing telegraph, timer, roster, damage, status, hazard-volume, room-seal, XP, loot, storage, and save owners retain their boundaries. Arena Hazards follows boss phase ids with readable warnings and armed volumes. A real boss defeat feeds ordinary XP, mastery, and loot, while one stable boss completion id can separately credit mastery. Failure, reset, restoration, and post-boss add cleanup cannot replay spawns, attacks, hazards, or rewards. All builds, enemies, arenas, attacks, conditions, items, UI, and balance remain host supplied.

acceptanceCriteria: Legacy phaseThresholds bosses and automatic interval-driven Arena Hazards retain their behavior when scripted encounters and bossDriven activation are absent.

The first scripted boss phase enters on engagement; later phases enter in declared order only when their health, elapsed-time, or matched condition trigger is satisfied, with stable phase and condition ids recorded once.
A condition for another encounter, a repeated condition, a stale timer, or an unrelated defeat changes no boss phase, add, enrage, completion, or reward state.

Each phase add spawns at most once with stable encounterId, phaseId, spawnId, tier, archetype, and masteryTags; Unit Roster alone owns its position and health, and Enemy Tier Scaling applies base level stats once.
Elite and boss attacks share cooldown, locked-target windup, interrupt, commit, and cancellation rules; every commit emits at most one attackCommitted and one ordinary combat.hit for Damage Resolver.
A boss phase replacement, declared interrupt, caster or target defeat, encounter failure, completion, or reset cancels the old windup without damage, loot, or mastery.

Boss-driven Arena Hazards selects only declared hazardPhase ids, waits a positive warning before arming, and leaves Hazard Volume as the only contact reporter and Timer System as the only countdown source.

Default hazardDamageMode=ignore preserves legacy hazard responses; opt-in contactDamage resolves only nonlethal positive-damage contacts through Damage Resolver and deduplicates stable contact ids without re-emitting combat.hit.
Enrage fires once from its stable timer, publishes replacement attacks and behavior modifiers plus an optional hazard phase, and does not become a timed Status Effect or a second damage pipeline.

A matching boss entityDefeated emits bossDefeated and exactly one bossEncounterCompleted with a stable completionId; that ordinary defeat independently feeds XP, defeat-based mastery, and Drop Director, while completion-based mastery deduplicates completionId.
allowReplay=false rejects another completed-encounter start; failure and reset are retryable but never complete the boss or grant completion mastery.
Failure, reset, and post-completion add cleanup remove living owned units through unitRemoved, never entityDefeated, so they cannot grant XP, mastery, loot, or a room-clear fact.
Boss Room Seal alone owns doors and its durable clear fact; failure or reset may reopen for retry without marking the boss defeated, and duplicate completion does not emit another clear transition.

Restored specialization, mastery, elite state, boss phases and conditions, spawn ledgers, telegraphs, hazard phases, contact ids, and room state emit no historical selections, spawns, hits, hazards, completions, or rewards.
Intent Marks and its hazard projection can be removed without changing targets, timers, phase transitions, contact, damage, encounters, mastery, loot, or persistence.

Damage Resolver remains the only final-damage owner, Status Effects the only timed-effect ledger, Drop Director the only drop eligibility and roll-count owner, and Slotted Bag or Core Inventory the only item-capacity owner.

Removing the boss and arena slice leaves specialization, mastery from other declared sources, elite waves, ordinary damage, and loot functional; removing Arena Hazards leaves boss phases, attacks, completion, and rewards functional.

Malformed arenas, dangling hazard phases, impossible transition ordering, duplicate phase/attack/condition ids, unreadable arming phases, invalid adds, and invalid enrages fail content validation before runtime.

Identical content, seeds, restored state, condition deliveries, target selections, timer inputs, and stable event ids reproduce phases, adds, telegraphs, hazards, defeats, rewards, and saves deterministically.
